raw.rationale: A prostanoid receptor agonist with HPGD annotation is unlikely to show lineage-selective cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM in a 5-day PRISM screen; prostaglandin signaling can affect proliferation in some contexts but no strong lineage-specific dependency or published selective-kill evidence supports any lineage. Thus probabilities remain near the low base rate, with slight elevation only for lineages where prostanoid/HPGD biology is more plausibly relevant.
